kit: Eva by WearMeds · Codex kit v2 · Sanjo-X · NASA Space Apps 2026

api._note: Check the current OpenAI Images API docs and fix these keys here (not in the prompts) if names or values changed.

designs.wristband: Eva wristband: a wide forearm band (about 9 cm wide) in matte warm-white soft-touch polymer with a thin graphite inner edge, carrying a large flexible touch screen that curves around the top of the forearm (active area about 11 x 6 cm, long side along the arm), thin even bezel, one tiny green status LED at the near edge. The screen is pure black #000000, perfectly uniform, only a faint soft sheen, nothing displayed.
designs.harness: Eva harness: a slim modular body harness of matte warm-white and soft-grey technical webbing with rounded white polymer clips. Two shoulder straps and one torso strap meet at a flat rounded core module on the sternum (ECG and breathing sensors). Two thin defibrillation electrode pads sit in low-profile white pockets, one below the right collarbone and one on the left side below the ribs. A small sealed capsule-shaped compartment on the left torso strap holds an emergency autoinjector (closed, nothing visible inside). Each pad pocket and the compartment has a tiny pill-shaped status light, unlit. Calm, medical-grade, believable 2030s consumer design, not military, not sci-fi armor.

cameras.ORBIT: 85mm product lens, camera 20 degrees above the device. The band is closed in its worn oval shape as if on an invisible forearm; the forearm axis is horizontal; the screen is on top, facing up and toward the camera. Device yaw {yaw} degrees (0 = forearm axis parallel to the image plane; positive = right end turns toward the camera), rotating about a vertical axis through the screen centre. Centered, about 8% padding. The studio light stays fixed (key upper left) and does not rotate with the device.
cameras.WX: Same rig as the orbit set at yaw 25 degrees: 85mm lens, camera 20 degrees above, band closed in its worn oval shape, forearm axis horizontal, screen on top. Every part is drawn exactly where it sits in the assembled device, same scale, perspective and light, so the layers stack back into the assembled image. Centered on the assembled device, about 8% padding.
cameras.WA: 70mm lens looking straight down the screen normal, so the curved screen reads as a nearly flat, front-facing rounded rectangle (easy to place HTML UI over it); a forearm crosses the frame horizontally, wrist toward the right, cropped by both side edges; device centered, about 10% padding top and bottom.
cameras.HX: Ghost-mannequin product view: the harness as worn by an invisible adult torso (no body visible), torso turned 25 degrees to camera-right (front 3/4), camera at chest height, 85mm lens, centered, about 8% padding. Every part is drawn exactly where it sits in the assembled harness, same scale, perspective and light, so the layers stack back into the assembled image.
cameras.FIG: Full body, front 3/4 (body turned 25 degrees to camera-right), camera at chest height, 70mm lens, centered, about 8% padding, feet visible.
cameras.PL: Sphere centered, diameter 76% of the canvas width. Light comes from camera-left, 15 degrees above the horizon (the Sun is off-frame left). The day/night terminator crosses the disc at about 70% of its width from the left; the night side falls to black.
cameras.SUN: Sun disc centered, diameter 50% of the canvas width, empty room around it.
cameras.SHIP: Pure side elevation, nose pointing right, 135mm lens, ship horizontal and centered, about 8% padding.

style.scene-black: Look: premium product photography, Apple-keynote clean, photoreal CGI, soft studio light: key from upper left (10 o'clock, 45 degrees), crisp white rim light on edges from behind right, no purple or coloured ambient light. The subject sits in a pool of light and everything falls off smoothly into pure #000000 toward all four edges (strong vignette); the outer 6% of the frame is pure #000000.
style.scene-white: Look: premium product photography, Apple-keynote clean, photoreal CGI, high-key and airy: large soft key from upper left (10 o'clock, 45 degrees) plus overhead softbox, light materials, no coloured ambient light. The scene dissolves smoothly into pure #FFFFFF toward all four edges (soft white vignette); the outer 6% of the frame is pure #FFFFFF, no grey corners.
style.product-black: Look: Apple-keynote product shot. Pure #000000 seamless background, no floor line, no gradient, no haze. Soft key from upper left (10 o'clock, 45 degrees) and crisp white rim light on the right and top edges; shadows fall into black.
style.product-white: Look: Apple-keynote product shot. Pure #FFFFFF seamless background, no floor line, no grey gradient. Soft large key from upper left (10 o'clock, 45 degrees) plus overhead softbox, high-key; only a soft contact shadow directly under the object, no cast shadow on the background.
style.layer: Isolated on a fully transparent background (alpha): no backdrop, no floor, no shadow, no glow unless asked. Same studio light as every Eva asset: soft key from upper left (10 o'clock, 45 degrees), gentle neutral rim light from the right. Whole object visible.
style.glow: Only light, no hardware or solid objects. Fully transparent background; light falls off softly to zero alpha; no hard edges, no backdrop.
style.space-black: Pure #000000 background, no gradient, no vignette, no haze, no nebula.
style.fullbleed: Photoreal, premium, soft natural light from the left, no vignette, no coloured haze.

rules: No text, letters, numbers or UI anywhere. No logos, insignia, flags, patches or brands. Device screens pure black #000000. No recognizable or visible faces. No needles, blood or gore.

sets.wristband-orbit: Crossfade turntable: OR-60, OR-30, OR0, OR+30, OR+60 (same camera, light fixed).
sets.wristband-exploded: Anchor WX0; parts WX1-WX4 stack back into WX0. Animate with CSS translate along the screen normal (up-left in image space), 0 to ~12% of width.
sets.harness-exploded: Anchor HX0; parts HX1-HX5 stack back into HX0. Animate parts outward from the core module with CSS translate/scale.
sets.planets: Earth, Mars, Sun with separate glow layers; light from the left on all.
sets.space-fx: Flare and particle layers, flow left to right (from the Sun toward the ship).
